Traffic volume data and accident studies provided the basis for intersection improvement plans. It is planned that the existing five-legged intersections of Lincoln Highway, Governor's Highway and Crawford Avenue be redesigned to provide two four-legged right-angle crossings. This will reduce vehicle conflicts, simplify signalization and reduce driver decision making. Lincoln Highway intersections with Main Street and Olympian Way also will be improved as will those of Lincoln Highway at Orchard Drive, Western Avenue, Hilltop Avenue and Division Street. In addition, the intersection of Western Avenue with Illinois Street will be upgraded. (See Exhibit 4.)
The design criteria and roadway geometrics for this project were based on standards of the Federal Aid Urban Streets of the U.S. Department of Transportation and the design policies of the State of Illinois, in effect during the study period. Studies of highway and railroad structures were based on accepted design criteria of the American Association of State Highway Officials (AASHO) the American Railroad Engineering Association (AREA), the Illinois Central Railroad, and the State of Illinois.
The following structures are to be replaced or added:
